data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 we were able to release prior year reserves of $180.2m (2015: $177.6m). Our specialty lines division increased their reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures; a trend which we expect to see continuing. This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect that reduced margins have on reserve releases is now visable. prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of prior year reserves as the post-recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures, leading to increased reserve releases in specialty lines.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a $180.2m release of prior year reserves in 2016, driven largely by favourable development and maturation of the post-recession portfolio (notably affecting specialty lines). These favourable movements were partly offset by reduced releases in short-tail classes due to the mechanical effect of reduced margins.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2016 we were able to release prior year reserves of $180.2m (2015: $177.6m).
Our specialty lines division increased their reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures; a trend which we expect to see continuing.
This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect that reduced margins have on reserve releases is now visable.
Overall, the claims environment has been favourable during 2016 with a relatively modest incidence of natural catastrophe claims notifications.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from Managing Agent narrative ('release prior year reserves of $180.2m') and supported by the divisional release table on same page. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2015). Mapping of report division names to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate for 'Specialty lines' and 'Political risks and contingency'. Amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD).
